title: Furniture & Tech
description: Enhance your Minecraft builds with interactive, customizable furniture and decor. From modern designs to culturally inspired pieces — beauty and functionality in every room.
body:
# Unmasked & Kesoh Modpack

This Modpack is selected with immersive furniture mods bundled to revolutionize your Minecraft build experience. Designed for the Fabric modloader, these mods introduce highly detailed, functional, and customizable furniture pieces, blending aesthetics and utility. Whether you're crafting cozy cottages or majestic castles, this modpack elevates your creativity and gameplay.

---

## Customizable & Interactive Furniture

- **Functional Furniture:** Add life to your builds with chairs, couches, tables, and bookshelves that aren't just decorative but fully interactive. Sit down, store items, and engage with your environment like never before.
- **Personalized Designs:** Choose from a wide array of materials — wood, stone, metal, and textiles — to craft furniture that fits your unique style.
- **Utility-Driven Options:** Equip your builds with practical furniture like storage chests, crafting stations, and fully functional kitchen pieces for an efficient and stunning home.
- **Optimized for Fabric:** Experience smooth performance with mods specifically tailored for the Fabric framework.

---

## Exotic, Culturally Inspired Creations

- **Global Designs:** Explore furniture and decor inspired by cultures worldwide, including Asian, medieval, and Mediterranean styles. Create anything from a serene tea room to a regal medieval hall.
- **Unique Decorations:** Beautify your world with rugs, lanterns, tapestries, and other exotic items that add charm and authenticity to your spaces.
- **Themed Materials:** Utilize specialty blocks and furniture types to craft extraordinary interiors and exteriors with a culturally authentic touch.

---

## Built for Performance

- **Fabric Integration:** Enjoy a lag-free experience with mods optimized for Fabric. Easily compatible with other mods for an expanded gameplay experience.
- **User-Friendly Crafting:** Intuitive crafting recipes and straightforward mechanics make furnishing your Minecraft world easy and enjoyable for players of all skill levels.

---

## Create Your Dream Minecraft Home

With the Unmasked & Kesoh modpack, you're not just decorating — you're transforming your Minecraft world into a masterpiece. From functional kitchens to culturally inspired palaces, these mods bring your vision to life.

---
